moves.name: 👋 Say Hi (Left-Paw Wave)
moves.vibe: Shifts onto 3-leg tripod (RF+RR+LR) and waves left front paw 3 times
moves.music_fit: Song intros, vocal greetings & ending pose

moves.name: 🐱 Lucky Cat (Right-Paw Wave)
moves.vibe: Shifts onto 3-leg tripod (LF+LR+RR) and beckons with right front paw

moves.name: 🤝 Friendly Handshake
moves.vibe: Balances on 3 legs, extends left front paw forward, and shakes 5 times

moves.name: ✋ High-Five Salute!
moves.vibe: Reaches left front paw 99mm up in the air on a stable tripod hold
moves.music_fit: Big musical hits, snare claps & finale salutes

moves.name: 🐶 Proud Sit & Head Tilt
moves.vibe: Sits squarely on rear haunches (-27° pitch) and pans head left & right
moves.music_fit: Calm vocal verses or attentive intro

moves.name: 🐕 Good Boy (Play-Bow & Wag)
moves.vibe: Drops front chest right to the desk with tail high and wags head

moves.name: 👀 Curious Check Around
moves.vibe: Dips left and right shoulders while looking ±45° across the desk
moves.music_fit: Quiet song intro before the beat drops

moves.name: 👃 Sniff the Desk
moves.vibe: Lowers nose down to 34mm above the desk and sniffs side-to-side
moves.music_fit: Intro exploration before standing up to dance

moves.name: 😎 Yoga Cobra Stretch
moves.vibe: Deep rear-leg extension (92°) with chest tall and proud head sway
moves.music_fit: Dramatic melodic swells or curtain-call stretch

moves.name: 💪 Full Plank Push-Ups
moves.vibe: Drops into a wide plank and pumps chest from 58mm down to 10mm 4 times

moves.name: ⚡ Crouch & Pop Beat Bounce
moves.vibe: Full-body vertical squat (38mm) to tall pop (63mm) locked to the beat
moves.music_fit: Chorus beat drops & energetic dholak/drum pockets

moves.name: 💃 Sassy Shoulder & Head Sway
moves.vibe: Alternating ±15° left/right shoulder dips with ±42° head sweeps
moves.music_fit: Main chorus hooks (like the 'Chaiyya Chaiyya' shrug!)

moves.name: 🎵 Head Nod & Body Rock
moves.vibe: Forward-and-back torso pitch rock (±11°) with rhythmic head nod

moves.name: 🐾 Dig the Beat (DJ Paws)
moves.vibe: Crouches low and rapidly alternates front paws like scratching a record

moves.name: 🚶 Walk Forward
moves.vibe: Smooth 4-beat forward walking gait (+155mm across the desk)

moves.name: ⏪ Walk Backward
moves.vibe: Crisp reverse walking gait (-140mm backing up to center stage)
moves.music_fit: Backing up before a chorus drop

moves.name: 🔄 Pivot Spin & Beckon
moves.vibe: Steps in place to rotate on the desk and finishes with a proud look

sequences.name: 🐶 Routine 1: Cute Desk Companion (23s)
sequences.description: Curious check → Walk forward → Play-bow wag → Tripod Left-Paw Wave → Walk back to center → Proud Sit → Happy Bounce finale

sequences.name: 🕺 Routine 2: Footwork, Groove & DJ Paws (24s)
sequences.description: Beat Bounce → Sassy Shoulder Sway → Head Nod Rock → Dynamic Trot → DJ Dig Paws → Walk Backward → High-Five Salute

sequences.name: 💪 Routine 3: Acrobatic Fitness & Strut (26s)
sequences.description: Sniff Desk → Syncopated Funky Strut → 4× Full Plank Push-Ups → Yoga Cobra Stretch → Walk Back → Lucky Cat Right-Paw Wave → Play-Bow
